A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProofBridge study. Their text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices are readable and can be matched, including the renumbered appendix sections.

before.justification: v2 reports original retrieval and proof auto-formalization experiments in Tables 1–2, component ablations, domain results in Figure 3 and an illustrative inference example.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, ablations, domain results and the appendix inference example.

M1.justification: The MiniLM/ByT5 joint embedding, proof-state pooling, contrastive objective, retrieval-augmented Kimina fine-tuning and verifier-guided repair remain unchanged. Algorithm 1's formatting adjustment does not change its procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 38,951 NUMINAMATH-LEAN-PF pairs and 244 MINIF2F-TEST-PF problems, with the same mathematical domains and retrieval directions. Added provenance discussion does not establish additional evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Qwen3-Embedding-8B, E5-Mistral-7B-Instruct and all-MiniLM-L6-v2. Table 2 retains the same 13 comparison models, their participation across settings and the Herald-Translator to Kimina-Prover-Distill-8B pipeline.

E3.justification: The 35,056/3,895 retrieval split, top-five demonstrations, repair budget, TC/SC evaluation, pass@k settings and training/decoding hyperparameters are unchanged. Appendix A.2's hyperparameter documentation moves to A.3.

E4.justification: The in-context-example comparisons, SFT/retrieval/repair ablations and Figure 3 domain analysis are retained. The complete illustrative example moves from Appendix A.4 to A.5 without changing its outputs or analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same similarity medians and quartiles and candidate-sampling description. Neither adds repeated-seed estimates, confidence intervals, significance tests or another uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 contain identical results, and Figure 3 and the appendix example retain their findings. For example, ProofBridge's NL-to-FL Recall@1 remains 52.83%, and its final pass@32 SC/TC remain 62.70%/95.49%.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(2), the proof-state formalization, semantic-equivalence definitions and worked Lean equivalence proofs are retained. Revised database notation and the added explanation of first-class functions do not introduce new mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: v3 removes the abstract's guarantee that embeddings are close if and only if pairs are semantically equivalent. This narrows an absolute claim while retaining the central framework and performance contributions. Section 2 also corrects the distinction between type checking and semantic correctness.

C2.justification: Section 5.1 removes the inference that successful dataset-proof repairs show the issues were mostly syntactic rather than mathematical. The main retrieval explanations, few-shot interpretations and semantic-equivalence qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 adds a project repository URL, describes code and dataset access and setup documentation, and discusses provenance and licensing. Hardware and hyperparameters remain unchanged. Section 5.1 drops explicit exact-string matching and some informalization-input details.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations concerning specialized reasoning, model cost, leanblueprint and software/data handling. The central positioning against auto-formalization, proof synthesis and retrieval work remains stable; many other reference changes update publication metadata.

P1.justification: v3 standardizes 'theorem+proof' terminology and streamlines several introductory, related-work and method paragraphs. It adds an LLM-use declaration and expands the reproducibility appendix, while preserving the main section order and narrative.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives label, spacing and caption refinements. Conference headers and a corresponding-author footnote are added, Algorithm 1 is compacted, and appendix code boxes reflow across pages. The same three figures and two tables remain.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a concrete code/dataset access point and describes reproduction resources in Appendix A.2, while removing the unsupported absolute embedding guarantee and clarifying metric terminology. These improve accessibility and precision. Some preparation detail is lost in Section 5.1, and the experimental evidence is unchanged, so the net improvement is limited.
